fields.text: JCG isn't a formal class—it's a relaxed hangout. We break into small groups based on skill level. Some days we play language games, other days we just chat about hobbies, anime, or life in Ottawa over snacks.
Just show up! JCG is free for all uOttawa students. You don't need to be a JSA member to drop in and see what it's like.
Practice basic greetings and survival phrases.
Deep dives into culture and natural slang.
Typically ~3h, feel free to leave whenever
Later start this wednesday since the room is booked before.
Bringing a friend may get you more fun
Don't worry. We've got activities for everyone. Come join us and have a good time.

fields.description: Our first JCG session of the Fall 2026 Semester. We were so surprised with the turnout, it was huge. We were so happy to see everyone laughing and making friends too.
This was a regular JCG, nothing to see. But turnout was especially high given the start of the semester. There's so much going on in here.
